prompt.zh: 在 GPT-2 上实现不含结束符处理的 beam search。测试会检查宽度为 1 时与贪心解码一致，宽度为 4 时与 `model.generate(num_beams=4)` 的结果一致，并比较两者找到的序列的对数概率。运行后请阅读打印出的文本，注意概率更高的续写是否读起来更好。
prompt.en: Implement beam search without end-of-sequence handling on GPT-2. The tests check that width 1 agrees with greedy decoding, that width 4 agrees with the result of `model.generate(num_beams=4)`, and compare the log-probabilities of the sequences the two find. Read the printed texts afterwards and consider whether the more probable continuations read better.

hints.zh: `total = (scores[:, None] + logp).view(-1)` 把所有候选排成一个长度为 `b * V` 的向量，对它做 `topk(beam_size)`。
hints.en: `total = (scores[:, None] + logp).view(-1)` lines all candidates up in a vector of length `b * V`, on which `topk(beam_size)` is taken.

hints.zh: 由扁平下标还原出 `parent = flat // V` 和 `token = flat % V`，新的候选是 `torch.cat([beams[parent], token[:, None]], dim=1)`。
hints.en: Recover `parent = flat // V` and `token = flat % V` from the flat index. The new candidates are `torch.cat([beams[parent], token[:, None]], dim=1)`.
